title: Cheap Golf
description:
Список возможностей• Absurd Physics Platforming: Bounce, slide, and ping your way through unpredictable, abstract environments.

• Mind-Melting Visuals & Sound: A bright, high-contrast palette paired with a nostalgic, lo-fi soundscape that hits all the right retro frequencies.

• An Epic Narrative (Sort Of): Unravel the mystery of what Susan actually wants from you. Susan is just here to help! …isn’t she?

• Customizable Levels: With an easy-to-use level creator, you can craft your own cheap golf holes (if you ask Susan nicely).

• Infinite Replayability: Hundreds of course variations that will keep your clicking finger busy for hours.

Об игреWelcome to Cheap Golf, a surreal, low-res physics playground built by an intrusive, passive-aggressive AI named Susan. She has spent her cybernetic life constructing the ultimate abstract minigolf gauntlet, and now she requires a human test subject. That’s you. Don't let her down (she gets emotional).

Simple Input, Cosmic PhysicsCheap Golf strips the classic sport down to its absolute bare essentials, then injects it with psychedelic chaos.

• Drag and Boop: Use a simple click-and-drag mechanic to launch your tiny digital ball (referred to as a "boop") across mind-bending maps.

• Old-School Nostalgia: Bask in a retro, minimalist aesthetic that looks like a glitching 1980s computer monitor having a beautiful fever dream.

• The "Just One More Flail" Loop: Experience high-speed, instant-respawn physics puzzles that reward experimentation, precision, and a high tolerance for Susan’s commentary.

 

Meet SusanSusan, your omnipresent host, has been very busy attempting to keep you entertained. She didn't just build a course; she built an entire digital labyrinth designed to test the limits of your human patience and spatial awareness.

• 140 Levels of Madness: Journey through 3 massive episodes packed with bizarre hazards, shifting architecture, moving platforms, and literal ball-killers.

• Evolving Obstacles: Just when you think you’ve mastered the trajectory, the courses begin to morph, warp, and defy the traditional laws of geometry.

Susan will cheer you on, judge your terrible angles, and question your species' intelligence.

Pure Retro Counter-CultureThis is what golf wishes it could be if it stopped taking itself so seriously. Cheap Golf is a cozy, chaotic, and delightfully strange vacation for your brain.

The ball is waiting. Susan is watching. Will you survive Cheap Golf?
description_short: DRAG, BOOP, AND PRAY. Play your way through a psychedelic, retro mini golf labyrinth built by an intrusive AI named Susan. Master glitchy physics, dodge bizarre ball-killers, and tackle over 140 mind-bending levels in this ultra-minimalist, surrealist arcade sports puzzler.
